prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 异常长值 · 标签列中的一个长值 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 230px
  col 2: header "级别" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "人口（万）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 200px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比各城市的级别、人口和备注，并呈现一个名称及级别说明明显较长的特殊案例。","reading":"读者先按城市定位行，再横向查看级别、人口和备注；比较人口时可沿数字列纵向扫描。长城市名所在行较高，适合同时容纳该行级别说明的换行。","groups":["城市和级别共同标识及描述每条记录；两列的长值出现在同一行，可以共享该行增加的高度。","人口是便于纵向比较的数值列；备注提供补充语境。"],"keep_intact":["人口数字及其千位分隔符","简短级别值，如一线、新一线","城市名称应保持易于连续阅读，避免过窄导致逐字换行"],"may_wrap":["特别长的城市名称可在汉字之间换行","长级别说明可按自然语义位置换行","备注中的说明文字可自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [200, 250, 98, 171] · table 720×278px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [251, 235, 98, 135] · table 720×278px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [190, 230, 98, 201] · table 720×278px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"城市和级别两列有足够的横向空间，长值都控制在两行；人口列的标题和数字完整，备注也能在两行内读完。整行高度一致，比较容易横向追读。","problems":"长城市名与长级别说明都在词组中间换行，读者需要在两行之间重新衔接；备注的换行也稍显零碎。","cause":"城市列宽200px、实际文字宽179px，无法容纳完整长名称；级别列宽250px、备注列宽171px，也都不足以容纳各自的长值。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"长城市名完整保留在一行，便于按城市定位；人口列保持紧凑，长值行仍只有两行。","problems":"城市列为一个异常值留出了较多空白，级别和备注显得偏挤；备注被分成两段，右侧留白也较少。","cause":"城市列251px恰好容纳230px的最长内容，因此压缩了级别列至235px、备注列至135px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"备注列较宽，短备注周围留白充足；人口列完整且便于纵向比较，长值行仍控制在两行。","problems":"城市和级别的长值都被较早截断，而备注长值依然换行，末行只剩很短的文字；相对记录的识别信息，备注占据的宽度偏多。","cause":"备注列201px仍小于其221px的单行所需宽度，同时城市列190px、级别列230px限制了两个主要长值的可读宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[200,260,98,161],"change":"以r1A为基础，将备注列的10px移给级别列，尝试让较长的级别说明在更自然的位置换行，同时保持城市和人口列的宽度。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[251,245,98,125],"change":"保留r1B中完整的一行城市名，将10px从备注移给级别，检验在备注仍为两行的前提下，能否改善级别说明的断行。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[235,245,98,141],"change":"尝试折中分配：城市列接近长名称的单行需求，级别和备注也获得比r1B更均衡的空间；观察城市名剩余部分是否形成可接受的第二行。"}]}
